objective: Independently review the two modules where correctness is the product's promise: the grounding check (does it still refuse fabricated facts while accepting ordinary English?) and the model integration path (does a real model reply actually reach the user?).

tasks.brief: Read server/lib/cv/tailor.js and server/lib/cv/refine.js as they stand, plus their tests, and judge two things. FIRST: does the grounding check still refuse a fabricated employer, job title, qualification, date or figure? Look for the mechanisms that decide whether a capitalised token is a name (SENTENCE_START_WORDS, COMMON_OPENERS, couldBeName, isNameShaped) and the ownership-tier verb guard, then judge whether any of them creates a bypass - a way for an invented fact or a promoted verb to pass. SECOND: is the check over-eager in a way that rejects ordinary English, which was a real defect: 'Delivers a 40% reduction', 'Use a plainer tone' and 'Go-based services' were all refused at different times. Report the mechanism, any bypass you can demonstrate, and any ordinary phrasing you believe would still be wrongly refused, with file and line references. You may run the existing module tests; do not edit any file and do not delegate further. Exact candidate: main at 86b74c3a1869255ce276cfe961474193d6080ca0. First verify cwd/repo HEAD and target source hashes; if candidate source drift exists return BLOCKED. You are not alone in the codebase: preserve all other changes, including parent receipt/spec writes. This is a read-only leaf review: no file writes, code edits, commits, Git writes, delegates, top-level threads, HTTP/model/API calls, credential reads, browser use, configuration/service/process mutations, or source-tree mutations. No Claude. Use Windows PowerShell and the existing Windows Node; no WSL needed. After source inspection only the existing pure grounding unit tests server/lib/cv/tailor.test.mjs and server/lib/cv/refine.test.mjs may run; no broad suites, E2E driver, servers, or live product probes. Do not weaken assertGrounded/groundChanges. Return full PASS/REQUEST_CHANGES/BLOCKED findings with reproducible input, file:line evidence, actual commands/results, source SHA256 hashes, no-write confirmation and NOT RUN limitations. Read-only is prompt scope, not OS confinement. Do not read secrets or execute documentation credential examples.

Lists ordinary-English phrasings that would still be wrongly refused, or states that none were found and why.
Verdict PASS, REQUEST_CHANGES or BLOCKED with file:line evidence.
